title: Local AI Agents with LangGraph, Ollama and Open WebUI
summary: Riccardo Pirruccio runs agents on his own hardware with Ollama and Open WebUI instead of paid APIs.
learn: LangChain's data frame agent lets you ask questions about Excel or CSV data in natural language.
LangGraph lets agents with one task each work together; his design has a data frame, writer and publisher agent.
Ollama downloads models and runs them on your own hardware, with Docker and tool calling support.
Open WebUI gives a ChatGPT-style interface with custom tools and pipelines for your models.
His home setup uses Docker Compose, with Cloudflare and Google authentication for remote access.
